# this is update on 09192026 from the beginning data loading
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tableone)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

# Load your data
meta_data <- read_csv("data/meta_data.csv")

## updated on 8/29(9 patients with >4 SES)
## 082526
meta_data <- meta_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    total_ses_cd_score <= 4,
    pro_grp %in% c("High-PRO", "Low-PRO")
  )

# Check the structure
dim(meta_data)
table(meta_data$pro_grp)

yn_factor <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x == ""] <- NA
  factor(x, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
}

meta_unique <- meta_data %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    current_biologic_any = case_when(
      is.na(current_biologic) ~ NA_character_,
      current_biologic == "No" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    ),

    current_5_asa = yn_factor(current_5_asa),
    current_steroids = yn_factor(current_steroids),
    current_immunomodulator = yn_factor(current_immunomodulator),
    current_biologic_any = yn_factor(current_biologic_any),

    prior_small_bowel_resection = yn_factor(prior_small_bowel_resection),
    prior_stricturoplasty = yn_factor(prior_stricturoplasty),
    antibiotics = yn_factor(antibiotics),

    prior_colon_resection_any = case_when(
      is.na(prior_colon_resection) ~ NA_character_,
      prior_colon_resection == "No" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    ),
    prior_colon_resection_any = yn_factor(prior_colon_resection_any),

    gender = factor(na_if(gender, "")),
    race = factor(na_if(race, "")),
    ethnicity = factor(na_if(ethnicity, "")),
    crohns_location = factor(na_if(crohns_location, "")),
    smoking_history = factor(na_if(smoking_history, ""))
  )

if ("prior_ileostomy_colostomy" %in% names(meta_unique)) {
  meta_unique <- meta_unique %>%
    mutate(
      prior_ileostomy_colostomy = yn_factor(prior_ileostomy_colostomy)
    )
}

vars <- c(
  "age",
  "gender",
  "race",
  "ethnicity",
  "bmi",
  "time_from_diagnosis",
  "crohns_location",

  "current_5_asa",
  "current_steroids",
  "current_immunomodulator",
  "current_biologic_any",

  "total_ses_cd_score",
  "calprotectin",

  "prior_ileostomy_colostomy",
  "prior_small_bowel_resection",
  "prior_colon_resection_any",
  "prior_stricturoplasty",

  "smoking_history",
  "antibiotics"
)

vars <- vars[vars %in% names(meta_unique)]

factor_vars <- c(
  "gender",
  "race",
  "ethnicity",
  "crohns_location",

  "current_5_asa",
  "current_steroids",
  "current_immunomodulator",
  "current_biologic_any",

  "prior_ileostomy_colostomy",
  "prior_small_bowel_resection",
  "prior_colon_resection_any",
  "prior_stricturoplasty",

  "smoking_history",
  "antibiotics"
)

factor_vars <- factor_vars[factor_vars %in% names(meta_unique)]

table1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = vars,
  strata = "pro_grp",
  data = meta_unique,
  factorVars = factor_vars,
  includeNA = FALSE
)

table1_out <- print(
  table1,
  showAllLevels = FALSE,
  test = TRUE,
  smd = TRUE,
  missing = TRUE,
  quote = FALSE,
  noSpaces = TRUE,
  printToggle = FALSE
)

# write.csv(
#   table1_out,
#   "Table1_revision_simple.csv"
# )

table1_out
```

```{r}
      summarise(
```

```{r}
### Supplementary Table 4: segment-specific SES-CD mean/SD

segment_vars <- c(
  "ileal_ses_cd_score",
  "right_ses_cd_score",
  "transverse_ses_cd_score",
  "left_ses_cd_score",
  "rectum_ses_cd_score"
)

segment_labels <- c(
  ileal_ses_cd_score = "Ileal SES-CD, mean (SD)",
  right_ses_cd_score = "Right-colon SES-CD, mean (SD)",
  transverse_ses_cd_score = "Transverse-colon SES-CD, mean (SD)",
  left_ses_cd_score = "Left-colon SES-CD, mean (SD)",
  rectum_ses_cd_score = "Rectal SES-CD, mean (SD)"
)

mean_sd <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

segment_summary <- meta_unique %>%
  dplyr::select(pro_grp, all_of(segment_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(segment_vars),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(measure, pro_grp) %>%
  summarise(
    value = mean_sd(value),
    n_available = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, !!!segment_labels)) %>%
  dplyr::select(measure, pro_grp, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = pro_grp,
    values_from = value
  )

segment_summary
```
```{r}
median_iqr <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf(
    "%.2f [%.2f–%.2f]",
    median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

median_iqr_with_n <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf(
    "%.2f [%.2f–%.2f], n=%d",
    median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!is.na(x))
  )
}

other_summary <- meta_unique %>%
  group_by(pro_grp) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total SES-CD, mean (SD)` = mean_sd(total_ses_cd_score),
    `SES-CD = 4, n (%)` = sprintf(
      "%d (%.1f%%)",
      sum(total_ses_cd_score == 4, na.rm = TRUE),
      100 * mean(total_ses_cd_score == 4, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    `Fecal calprotectin, median [IQR]` = median_iqr(calprotectin),
    `CRP, median [IQR]` = median_iqr_with_n(crp),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -pro_grp,
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = pro_grp,
    values_from = value
  )

supp_table4 <- bind_rows(
  other_summary %>% dplyr::filter(measure %in% c("Total SES-CD, mean (SD)", "SES-CD = 4, n (%)")),
  segment_summary,
  other_summary %>% dplyr::filter(measure %in% c("Fecal calprotectin, median [IQR]", "CRP, median [IQR]"))
)

write.csv(
  supp_table4,
  "Supplementary_Table4_endoscopic_inflammatory_characteristics.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

supp_table4
```

```{r}
# Install required packages if not already installed
# install.packages("tableone")
# install.packages("readr")

# Load libraries
library(tableone)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

# Load your data
meta_data <- read_csv("data/meta_data.csv")

## updated on 8/29(9 patients with >4 SES)
## 082526
meta_data <- meta_data %>%
  filter(
    total_ses_cd_score <= 4,
    pro_grp %in% c("High-PRO", "Low-PRO")
  )

# Check the structure
dim(meta_data)
table(meta_data$pro_grp)

meta_unique <- meta_data %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  ## 08252026
  mutate(
    current_biologic_any = case_when(
      is.na(current_biologic) ~ NA_character_,
      current_biologic == "No" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    )
  )%>%
#meta_unique <- meta_unique %>%
  mutate(
    current_cd_medication = case_when(
      current_biologic != "No" ~ "Biologics",
      current_immunomodulator == "Yes" ~ "Immunomodulators",
      current_steroids == "Yes" ~ "Steroids",
      current_5_asa == "Yes" ~ "5-ASA",
      current_med_none == "No Therapy" ~ "None",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )) %>%
  mutate(current_cd_medication = factor(current_cd_medication,
                                        levels = c("5-ASA", "Steroids", "Immunomodulators", "Biologics", "None", "Other")),
    # updated on 04/16/2026 for showing missingness
    across(c(gender, race, ethnicity, crohns_location), ~na_if(., "")),
    gender = fct_explicit_na(factor(gender), na_level = "Missing"),
    race = fct_explicit_na(factor(race), na_level = "Missing"),
    ethnicity = fct_explicit_na(factor(ethnicity), na_level = "Missing"),
    crohns_location = fct_explicit_na(factor(crohns_location), na_level = "Missing"),
    current_cd_medication = fct_explicit_na(current_cd_medication, na_level = "Missing")
) 
  #filter(total_ses_cd_score <= 4)

# Set your grouping variable (replace 'Group' with actual column name if different)
# e.g., meta_data$Group might contain "high pro", "active CD", "low pro"
group_var <- "pro_grp"

# Define the variables to summarize (update based on your dataset)
# For example:
## 082526
vars <- c(
  "age",
  "gender",
  "race",
  "ethnicity",
  "bmi",
  "time_from_diagnosis",
  "crohns_location",
  "current_biologic_any",
  "current_immunomodulator",
  "current_steroids",
  "current_5_asa",
  "total_ses_cd_score",
  "calprotectin",
  "crp",
  "prior_small_bowel_resection",
  "prior_colon_resection",
  "prior_stricturoplasty",
  "smoking_history",
  "antibiotics"
)

# 设置分类变量（factor 类型）
## 082526
factor_vars <- c(
  "gender",
  "race",
  "ethnicity",
  "crohns_location",
  "current_biologic_any",
  "current_immunomodulator",
  "current_steroids",
  "current_5_asa",
  "prior_small_bowel_resection",
  "prior_colon_resection",
  "prior_stricturoplasty",
  "smoking_history",
  "antibiotics"
)

# 将 Yes/No 类型变量和其他分类变量转为 factor
meta_unique[factor_vars] <- lapply(meta_unique[factor_vars], factor)

#sum(meta_unique$total_ses_cd_score > 4, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create Table 1
table1 <- CreateTableOne(vars = vars, 
                         strata = group_var, 
                         data = meta_unique, 
                         factorVars = factor_vars,
                         includeNA = TRUE)

render_cont <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)
  s <- sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)
  if (is.na(s)) {
    sprintf("%.2f (0.00)", m)
  } else {
    sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", m, s)
  }
}

# Print Table 1
## 082526
table1_out <- print(
  table1,
  showAllLevels = TRUE,
  test = TRUE,
  smd = TRUE,
  missing = TRUE,
  nonnormal = c("calprotectin", "crp"),
  quote = FALSE,
  noSpaces = TRUE,
  printToggle = FALSE
)

table1_out
write.csv(table1_out, "Table1_revision.csv")
```

### segment-specific endoscopic activity
```{r}
segment_vars <- c(
  "ileal_ses_cd_score",
  "right_ses_cd_score",
  "transverse_ses_cd_score",
  "left_ses_cd_score",
  "rectum_ses_cd_score"
)

segment_summary <- meta_unique %>%
  select(pro_grp, all_of(segment_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(segment_vars),
    names_to = "segment",
    values_to = "segment_ses_cd"
  ) %>%
  group_by(pro_grp, segment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_available = sum(!is.na(segment_ses_cd)),
    median = median(segment_ses_cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(segment_ses_cd, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(segment_ses_cd, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zero = sum(segment_ses_cd == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gt0 = sum(segment_ses_cd > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  segment_summary,
  "segmental_SESCD_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

segment_summary

table(
  meta_unique$pro_grp,
  meta_unique$total_ses_cd_score == 4
)
```
